## Body

F270 R2 control replay at eebc702 replaces the old single outcome lookup with 1 call on a sender-refusal-key hit or 2 on a miss: increment versus R1 is0/+1. Each latest_matching_message is a schema PRAGMA plus a seat/kind-indexed SELECT with residual JSON msg_id, NOT a message-key point seek. For2,000 target control refusals:oldest12,042/newest28/missing12,015 VM instructions on SQLite3.54.1. A refused control ack also adds one separately committed/broadcast delivery.control-refused fact before its outcome and queue ack. Cost row must include that write, not just reads. Sources: delivery/mod.rs:1094-1148,2771-2818; spine.rs:397-419.

The sender-less record_delivered guard adds no SQL/retry task; failed ack rolls back and retains the running row. Expiry is lazy in a later claim pass. OMP/Pi claim_extension has a60s/default three-expiry budget plus Working renewal brake; ordinary/native/manual claim uses300s/default and does not spend that budget, so generic bodies can recycle without a fixed total cap. Running blocks its serial_key, not other recipients. The stock Copilot receiver rejects empty from before ack and holds/stops receiving; do not infer a stock bad-ack loop from the direct-store fixture.
